data.name: Praachi
data.gender_notes: Praachi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Praachi is a beautiful Hindu name, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Praasad' which means 'a boon or blessing from a God'. The name signifies the bestowal of prosperity and blessings in one's life. It is also believed that the name Praachi brings forth the creation of new beginnings and a prosperous future. The name Praachi carries the meaning “Prosperity, Creation” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi. Parents who choose Praachi usually hope their child will grow to embody prosperity, creation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Praachi is a powerful invocation to the divine, symbolizing the grace and blessings of the gods. It is a reminder of the spiritual journey we embark upon in life, seeking enlightenment and inner peace.
data.etymology: Praachi belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Prosperity, Creation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Praachi total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
